items.title: InvITs industry pushes for easier M&A rules to boost investor interest
items.description: India's InvITs sector, managing ₹7 lakh crore in assets, is urging regulators for simpler M&A rules. Industry leaders want change of control guidelines to match those for listed companies. This aims to attract more investors by streamlining acquisition processes. Current rules can make buyers acquire more units than intended.

items.title: Adani Power surges past Infosys in market capitalisation
items.description: Adani Power has surpassed Infosys in market capitalization, becoming the 11th most valuable company on Indian bourses. This shift is driven by Adani Power's 68% stock surge in 2026, while Infosys experienced a nearly 29% decline. Investors favor Adani Power due to rising energy demand, whereas concerns over AI's impact on traditional IT services have affected Infosys.

items.title: Nifty Midcap 100 scales fresh peak, analysts see more upside ahead
items.description: The Nifty Midcap 100 index reached a record high for the fourth consecutive session, driven by strong corporate earnings and promising growth outlooks. Analysts anticipate this momentum to continue, with potential for 20% gains in the medium term, as midcap and smallcap stocks attract significant investor interest.

items.title: States under fiscal strain amid high welfare spend: Morgan Stanley
items.description: States are facing fiscal pressure as revenue growth slows and welfare spending remains high, leading to elevated deficits. Morgan Stanley reports state fiscal deficits are projected to stay at 3.2% of GSDP through FY27, while the consolidated fiscal deficit is expected to rise to 7.9%.

items.title: Non-banks increase microfinance share amid muted demand
items.description: The overall microfinance gross loan portfolio stood at ₹3.34 lakh crore at the end of April, down from ₹3.39 lakh crore a month ago, said the credit information company.

items.title: HDFC Bank denies allegations of disguising interest payout
items.description: HDFC Bank stands resolutely against accusations of misconduct as an investigative report alleges that it masked differential interest payments to MSRDC as part of its marketing budget. The bank emphasizes its stringent internal controls and refutes any speculation of wrongdoing.

items.title: Avaada seeks $800 million to refinance Brookfield Asset Management debt
items.description: Avaada Group is raising $800 million to refinance existing debt. This move aims to reduce finance costs before the group's planned public market listing. The funds will come from offshore loans and local bonds. This refinancing will replace part of the debt from Brookfield Asset Management. Avaada is expanding its renewable energy and manufacturing businesses.

items.title: AkzoNobel rejects €12.5 billion Nippon Paint, Sherwin-Williams takeover offer
items.description: Dulux paint maker AkzoNobel has rejected a massive takeover offer. Rivals Nippon Paint and Sherwin-Williams proposed a €12.5 billion deal. AkzoNobel stated the offer undervalued its business and lacked certainty. The company board continues to back its planned merger with Axalta. Shareholders will vote on the Axalta deal soon. This rejection sent AkzoNobel shares soaring.

items.title: IDFC First Bank receives Rs 514.82 crore insurance payout on microfinance defaults, expects full provision write-back
items.description: IDFC First Bank has successfully secured a substantial allocation of over Rs 500 crore from the Credit Guarantee Fund for Micro Units. This funding is targeted at eligible microfinance loans and is expected to enhance the bank's financial performance by allowing it to reverse previously set aside provisions for defaults.

items.title: Gift Nifty tumbles nearly 2% after US-Iran exchange strikes in latest escalation
items.description: Gift Nifty 50 futures fell sharply, indicating that Indian markets are likely to open significantly lower on Friday. The decline followed fresh U.S. strikes on an Iranian military site, which intensified geopolitical tensions despite ongoing diplomatic talks between Washington and Tehran to resolve their three-month conflict.

items.title: Q4 earnings roundup: Raymond Realty, MCX among 19 companies that delivered 100%+ growth in sales and PAT
items.description: A select group of 19 large-cap BSE-listed companies achieved triple-digit growth in both profit and revenue during Q4FY26, indicating strong business momentum. Raymond Realty and 63 Moons Technologies were among the top performers, showcasing robust execution and demand. While many firms saw significant profit jumps, only a few managed to double both revenue and profit simultaneously.

items.title: Bharti Airtel, HAL, among 7 stocks that have upside potential of up 28%. Do you own any?
items.description: With geopolitical tensions escalating, crude oil prices climbing above $100 per barrel, and foreign investors continuing to pull money out of Indian equities, market sentiment remains fragile. Despite the volatility, ICICI Securities has picked 7 largecap stocks across sectors that could offer meaningful upside potential, backed by strong fundamentals, sector leadership and long-term growth visibility.

items.title: Stock Market Holiday 2026: Are NSE, BSE closed today for Bakri Id? Check market closing dates list
items.description: Indian stock markets will be closed on May 28 for Bakri Id, marking another trading holiday in 2026. Following this, seven more market closures are scheduled throughout the year, including Muharram, Ganesh Chaturthi, and Diwali. MCX will have a partial closure, while NCDEX will be fully shut.

items.title: Vijay Kedia says long-term capital gains tax should be abolished for nation building. Here’s why
items.description: Ace investor Vijay Kedia has urged the government to abolish long-term capital gains (LTCG) tax on listed equities, stating that long-term investors should be recognized as contributors of patient capital rather than speculators. In a post on X, he emphasized that long-term shareholders help businesses grow, generate employment, drive innovation, and support India’s economic development.

items.title: Dolly Khanna’s portfolio sees steady gains in CY26; 5 stocks rise up to 25%
items.description: An ETMarkets analysis of ace investor Dolly Khanna’s portfolio shows that, based on shareholding data for the March 2026 quarter, she publicly holds around eight stocks. As of May 27, 2026, the total value of these holdings is approximately Rs 481 crore, up about 8% from Rs 444 crore in December 2025.In terms of performance, five of the eight stocks have gained between 4% and 26% so far in CY26, while the remaining three have declined between 15% and 22%. There were three fresh additions to the portfolio during the March 2026 quarter. (Data Source: ACE Equity, Trendlyne)

items.title: ​DMart, Meesho, among 10 stocks that saw highest increase in HNI holding in Q4. Check list
items.description: Even as markets remained volatile amid persistent FII selling, elevated crude oil prices, geopolitical tensions surrounding the Iran conflict and continued pressure on the rupee against the U.S. dollar, high net-worth investors increased their exposure to select companies during the March 2026 quarter, signalling pockets of confidence despite broader market uncertainty. Here’s the full list

items.title: ​12 Midcap stocks still down up to 50% from their yearly high despite index hitting 52-week high
items.description: Indian equities have remained volatile in recent months. While the benchmark Nifty 50 is still nearly 10% below its 52-week high, the broader market has shown surprising resilience, with the Nifty Midcap 150 touching a fresh 52-week high on May 27.However, the rally has been far from broad-based. Several midcap stocks continue to trade well below their peak levels. We identified 12 midcap names that are still down 40–50% from their respective 52-week highs, highlighting the sharp divergence within the broader market. (Data Source: ACE Equity)

items.title: Reliance Industries, Infosys, among 10 stocks which saw highest buying by retail investors in Q4
items.description: Amid sustained FII outflows, elevated crude oil prices above $100 per barrel, and rising geopolitical tensions linked to the Iran conflict, Indian equity markets have remained highly volatile in recent months. The weakening rupee against the U.S. dollar has further added to investor caution, even as retail participants continued selectively increasing exposure during the March 2026 quarter. 10 stocks where retail investors saw value in Q4.

items.title: Reliance Jio IPO soon? Mukesh Ambani to provide update on $4 bn public issue at upcoming AGM, says report
items.description: Mukesh Ambani is expected to share an update on Jio Platforms’ anticipated IPO at Reliance Industries’ June 19 AGM. Reports suggest Reliance is shifting towards a fresh issue structure to protect retail investors and strengthen Jio’s long-term growth and transparency roadmap.

items.title: Mukesh Ambani-led Reliance Industries' contribution to national exchequer rises to Rs 2.16 lakh crore
items.description: Reliance Industries’ contribution to the national exchequer rose nearly 3% to Rs 2.16 lakh crore in FY26. The company said government payments formed the largest share of value created, while revenue, EBITDA and annual profit recorded strong year-on-year growth.

items.title: ET Alpha Wealth Summit: Navigating the great wealth shift in an uncertain market cycle
items.description: The ET Alpha Summit in Mumbai brings together leading market voices to explore how investors should navigate expensive markets amid geopolitical uncertainty, inflation and volatility. The sessions focus on Saurabh Mukherjea’s take on the disappearance of cheap stocks and the need to rethink valuation discipline, alongside Samir Arora’s view on where India’s next wave of wealth creation will emerge through structural shifts and evolving market leadership.

items.title: Mukesh Ambani draws zero salary again: India's richest man forgoes paycheck for 6th straight year
items.description: Reliance Industries Chairman Mukesh Ambani did not take any salary in FY26, continuing a six-year trend. Reliance reported strong annual revenue growth despite profit decline in Q4, while Ambani’s children and senior executives received commissions and remuneration.

items.title: For those who still have patience for long-term investing: 5 large-caps from different sectors with upside potential of up to 30%
items.description: The Indian markets are closed for trading, but the oil price is reacting to overnight noise on the US-Iran war. So, will we see more weakness in the market? But first, why the question mark at all? Because, there is a lot that could change between now and when the markets open on Friday morning. The best thing to do at this juncture is to ignore what happens on a day-to-day basis. In short, change your perspective.
